hero.title: Staff Application
hero.description: Fill out the form below honestly. Your answers help us understand your judgement and knowledge to join the Staff and the TierList.

tipo.label: Which role are you applying for?

labor_helper.label: Do you know what a Helper's job is?
labor_helper.placeholder: Describe in your own words a Helper's job

funciones_helper.label: Name 2 basic and essential functions of a Helper

claro_spam.label: Are you clear on the meaning of the term "Spam"?

detalle_spam.label: Explain what you understand by "Spam"
detalle_spam.placeholder: Briefly explain what you understand by "Spam"

claro_flood.label: Are you clear on the meaning of the term "Flood"?

detalle_flood.label: Explain what you understand by "Flood"
detalle_flood.placeholder: Briefly explain what you understand by "Flood"

conoce_hacks_ss.label: Do you have knowledge about hacks and how to perform a SS (ScreenShare)?

detalle_hacks_ss.label: Detail your knowledge
detalle_hacks_ss.placeholder: Detail your knowledge about hacks and how to perform a SS

opinion_tierlist.label: What do you think of the TierList? Mention positive and negative aspects, and suggest a concrete improvement
opinion_tierlist.placeholder: Positive aspects, negatives and a concrete improvement

usuarios_peleando.label: What would you do if you see two users fighting in general chat?

testers_peleando.label: What would you do if you see two Testers fighting in general chat?

ticket_tester.label: How would you respond to a ticket where someone asks how to apply for Tester?
ticket_tester.placeholder: Write your reply to the ticket

ticket_reporte.label: How would you respond to a ticket where someone is reporting another person?
ticket_reporte.placeholder: Write your reply to the ticket

hacks_pvp.label: Name 3 types of hacks focused on the PVP community (not basic ones like Fly or KillAura) and describe how you would identify them specifically
hacks_pvp.placeholder: Name 3 PVP hacks and how you would identify them

tiempo_disciplina.label: Do you have enough time and discipline to dedicate the effort and activity required by the TierList?

meta_principal.label: Being completely objective, what will be your main goal within the Staff and the TierList?

capacidad_resolucion.label: Do you consider that you have good abilities for solving problems and conflicts?

se_enoja_facil.label: Do you consider that you get angry easily?

modos.label: Which mode(s) do you want to test?

tier_modo.label: What tier are you in that mode? (Navy / McTiers)
tier_modo.placeholder: Mention your tier on Navy or McTiers

experiencia_tester.label: Do you have experience as a tester?

detalle_experiencia.label: Which TierLists have you taken part in?
detalle_experiencia.placeholder: Mention the TierLists you participated in

baneado.label: Have you ever been banned from a server?

detalle_baneado.label: For what reasons?
detalle_baneado.placeholder: Mention the reasons for the ban

opinion_navy.label: What do you think of Navy?

por_que_tester.label: Why do you want to be a tester on Navy?
por_que_tester.placeholder: Tell us why you want to be a tester

tiempo_testeos.label: How much time could you dedicate to testing?

servidores.label: Which servers do you usually play?
servidores.placeholder: Mention the servers you usually play

clanes_pvp.label: Have you belonged to PvP clans?

detalle_clanes.label: Which ones? Mention the names
detalle_clanes.placeholder: Mention the names of the clans

toxico.label: Do you consider yourself a toxic person?

sospecha_hacks.label: What would you do if you suspect the user you are testing is using hacks?

validation.nombreLength: The name must be between 2 and 60 characters
validation.tooShort: Develop your answer a bit more (minimum 10 characters)
validation.tooLong: You have exceeded the maximum allowed characters
validation.tipoRequired: Select which role you are applying for

success.title: Thanks for applying!
success.message: We have received your application successfully. Our team will review it and reach out if you move forward in the process. Good luck!

feedback.errorThrottle: You already submitted an application recently. Try again later.
feedback.errorDuplicated: An application with this Discord user already exists for this role.
feedback.errorValidation: Check the fields: some data is not valid.
feedback.errorUnexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
